register.reg_long_name: Activity Monitors Event Counter Virtual Offset Registers 1

purpose_text.para: Holds the 64-bit virtual offset for auxiliary activity monitor events.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

access_permission_text.para: If auxiliary counter <n> is not implemented, then reads and writes of AMEVCNTVOFF1<n>_EL2 are UNDEFINED.

note.para: AMCG1IDR_EL0 identifies which auxiliary activity monitor event counters have a corresponding virtual offset implemented.
